params.body:
Step 1 of the 2FA plan (open point `2026-09-15-2fa-en-passkeys`, "Twee eisen van Shane", point 1): once logged in, stay logged in.

## What changes

- `LoginController::login` passes the remember flag: `Auth::loginUsingId($user->id, Request::boolean('remember'))`. With the checkbox the response carries Laravel's recaller cookie (five years) and the user gets a `remember_token`; without it nothing changes. Until now the checkbox was read by nobody.
- The checkbox "Aangemeld blijven" on the login screen is checked by default (the label is hardcoded Dutch, no translation key, unchanged).
- `LoginController::logout`: `Auth::logout()` (expires the recaller cookie, rotates `remember_token`), then `Session::invalidate()` (empty session with a **new id**; `flush()` kept the id) and `Session::regenerateToken()`.
- Delegation ("log in as", `Delegation::start`/`stop`) and `VweSmoke` keep `Auth::login($user)` without the flag: a delegated session ends with the administrator's session. Pinned by a test.
- `.env.example`: `SESSION_DRIVER=database`, `SESSION_LIFETIME=43200` (30 days), one comment line. `config/session.php` untouched (env-driven).
- New migration `2026_09_18_100000_create_sessions_table.php` (`php artisan make:session-table` output; no `sessions` table existed in the schema dump or the migrations). Forge runs `migrate --force` in the deploy, so the table is there after the deploy.

## What Shane must set after the merge (production AND preview `.env`, in Forge)

```
SESSION_DRIVER=database
SESSION_LIFETIME=43200
```

Then `php artisan config:cache` / the deploy's optimize step (Forge does this in the deploy script, so setting the values before the deploy is enough). Until the driver is switched the app keeps using file sessions with the 120-minute lifetime; the existing file sessions in `storage/framework/sessions` simply expire and can be left alone (or the folder emptied later). Switching the driver logs everyone out once (their session id lives in the old store); with the remember cookie set on their next login that is the last time.

The `sessions` table gets one row per browser; Laravel's lottery (`config/session.php`, `lottery`) garbage-collects rows past the lifetime, nothing to schedule.

## Rules and decision

- New decision `docs/bedrijfsregels/bronnen/beslissingen/2026-09-18-lang-aangemeld.md` (anchor `lang-aangemeld`, Shane, 18 September 2026; quotes the open point, with the numbers 30 days / 43200 / five years in the quote).
- R P2-3.1 updated (mentions the checkbox, now `klant`), new R P2-3.8 (remember cookie, delegation excluded), P2-3.9 (checkbox default, `scherm`), P2-3.10 (30 days, database), P2-3.11 (logout clears both). `php bin/rules-sources`: "Geen problemen".

## Tests

`tests/Feature/LoginRememberTest.php` (5 tests, 28 assertions, all `@rule`-tagged): login with remember sets `remember_token` and the recaller cookie; login without sets neither; logout expires the recaller cookie, empties the session, gives it a new id and CSRF token and rotates `remember_token` (checked with the cookie sent back, as a browser would); the login page has the checkbox checked; delegation via `user.index.loginas` sets no recaller cookie. Mutation check: without the flag the first test fails.

Also run locally: `SmokeTest::test_pagina_geeft_geen_serverfout` (110 OK), `DelegationTest`, `AlpineExpressionTest`, `HandlerWiringTest`, `CompiledViewsTest`, `StylesheetSyntaxTest`, `RulesCoverageTest`, `RulesIdentityTest`, `RulesSourcesTest`, `LanguageParityTest`: 61 tests OK (1 pre-existing incomplete, not in this change).

## Screenshots

Login at 1440 and 390 after the change (only the checkbox is now checked): `.playwright-mcp/sessions/login-1440-after.png`, `.playwright-mcp/sessions/login-390-after.png`.

No hot shared files touched.
params.title: Login: remember me honoured and on by default, 30-day sessions in the database
